INSERT INTO hit_message_counts ( hit_id , type , received_date , total , distinct_count , duplicates , max_uphn_tranx_in_id ) WITH hit_data AS ( select 'CCD' type, trunc(receivedtime) receivedday, count(*) tot, count(distinct payloadname) dist,count(*)-count(distinct payloadname) dupes, max(uphn_tranx_in_id) max_uphn_tranx_in_id from uphn_tranx_in where uphn_tranx_in_id > (SELECT MAX(MAX_UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID) from HIT_MESSAGE_COUNTS where TYPE = 'CCD') and topic = 'DEERPROD' and trunc(receivedtime) > (select MAX(RECEIVED_DATE) from hit_message_counts where TYPE = 'CCD') and trunc(receivedtime) <= SYSDATE - 1 group by trunc(receivedtime)
union
select 'HL7' type, trunc(receivedtime) receivedday, count(*) tot, count(distinct payloadname) dist,count(*)-count(distinct payloadname) dupes, max(uphn_tranx_in_id) max_uphn_tranx_in_id from uphn_tranx_in where uphn_tranx_in_id > (SELECT MAX(MAX_UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID) from HIT_MESSAGE_COUNTS where TYPE = 'HL7') and topic = 'DEERHL7PROD' and payloadname like '%.txt' and trunc(receivedtime) > (select MAX(RECEIVED_DATE) from hit_message_counts where TYPE = 'HL7') and trunc(receivedtime) <= SYSDATE - 1 group by trunc(receivedtime)
union
select 'EXP' type, trunc(receivedtime) receivedday, count(*) tot, count(distinct payloadname) dist,count(*)-count(distinct payloadname) dupes, max(uphn_tranx_in_id) max_uphn_tranx_in_id from uphn_tranx_in where uphn_tranx_in_id > (SELECT MAX(MAX_UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID) from HIT_MESSAGE_COUNTS where TYPE = 'EXP') and topic = 'DEERHL7PROD' and trunc(receivedtime) > (select MAX(RECEIVED_DATE) from hit_message_counts where TYPE = 'EXP') and trunc(receivedtime) <= SYSDATE - 1 and payloadname like '%.csv' group by trunc(receivedtime)
order by receivedday, type ) SELECT hit_message_count_seq.nextval hit_id, a.type, a.receivedday, a.tot, a.dist, a.dupes, a.max_uphn_tranx_in_id FROM hit_data a

WITH hits_recd AS ( SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY a.received_date DESC) rn FROM hit_message_counts a --WHERE a.received_date < trunc(sysdate) ), distinct_type AS ( SELECT 1 slno, 'HL7' type FROM dual UNION SELECT 2 slno, 'CCD' type FROM dual UNION SELECT 3 slno, 'EXP' type FROM dual ) SELECT b.type "TYPE", a.received_date "LAST_RECEIVED", a.total "TOTAL", a.distinct_count "DISTINCT" , CASE WHEN a.type = 'HL7' AND a.received_date = TRUNC(sysdate) - 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END hl7_recd_yn , CASE WHEN a.type = 'CCD' AND a.received_date BETWEEN Trunc(next_day(sysdate,'MONDAY') - 7) AND Trunc(next_day(sysdate,'MONDAY') - 1) THEN 'Y' WHEN a.type = 'CCD' AND Trim(Upper(to_char(sysdate, 'DAY'))) = 'MONDAY' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ccd_recd_yn , CASE WHEN a.type = 'EXP' AND Trunc(sysdate) <= Trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 14 THEN 'Y' WHEN a.type = 'EXP' AND a.received_date BETWEEN Trunc(sysdate,'MM') AND Trunc(sysdate,'MM') + 14 THEN 'Y' WHEN (a.type = 'EXP' AND Trim(Upper(to_char(a.received_date, 'MONTH'))) = Trim(Upper(to_char(SYSDATE, 'MONTH')))) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END exp_recd_yn FROM hits_recd a RIGHT OUTER JOIN distinct_type b ON ( a.type = b.type AND rn = 1 ) ORDER BY slno
